description: This file declares APIs for managing interface stack objects in a data model, including functions to retrieve, update, and synchronize interface stack entries and their parameters.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of entries in the InterfaceStack.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetEntry
methods.description: Gets a specific entry from the InterfaceStack given an index and returns its handle and instance number.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_IsUpdated
methods.description: Checks if the InterfaceStack has been updated.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_Synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the current state of the InterfaceStack with the underlying data source.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for a given interface stack entry.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for a given interface stack entry.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for a given interface stack entry.

methods.name: InterfaceStack_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a given interface stack entry.
